stories.h: SR 167 Expressway tolls start Dec. 14 in Fife
stories.s: Starting at 5 a.m. Dec. 14, drivers between I-5 and SR 509 near the Port of Tacoma will pay $1 with a Good To Go pass and at least $2 more without one.

stories.h: Pierce Transit moves to buy up to 60 buses
stories.s: With Proposition 1 appearing to pass, the board unanimously let the CEO buy or refurbish up to 60 buses. The goal is to lock in manufacturing slots early because of supply backlogs.

stories.h: Rain, rising winds return Friday after mild Thursday
stories.s: Thursday stays mostly dry and mild in the low 60s, with winds picking up in the evening. Rain arrives Friday, and stronger winds are expected Saturday night into Sunday.

coming.h: Overnight lane closures on eastbound Tacoma Narrows Bridge
coming.s: The right two eastbound lanes, the toll plaza, and the 24th and 36th street on-ramps close 8 p.m. Friday to 6 a.m. Saturday for joint cleaning. Drivers will be detoured.

coming.h: Arts at the Armory in Tacoma
coming.s: Tacoma Arts Live hosts the free, all-ages event from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. at the Tacoma Armory on South Yakima Avenue.

coming.h: Peninsula Art League fine art show opens in Gig Harbor
coming.s: The 24th annual show opens Saturday at the Vintage Aero Museum and runs daily 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. through Dec. 2. Admission is $10 for adults.
